title: Care type skipped because of cost has distinct concurrent debt and expense distributions

observations.period: 2025; prescription medicine skipped because of cost

denominator.unit: respondents with observed E1_a and outcomes; yes/no care-type cells

observations.method: Weighted same-respondent cross-tab of E1_a with E2B and E2 using single-year weight.
observations.uncertainty: No replicate-weight standard errors; cells have separate valid-response universes and overlap other care types.
observations.counterinterpretation: Need, illness, coverage, access, and reverse timing may produce both foregoing and debt/expense.
